title: Anna's Town
text:
Anna lives in a small town. There is a big park near her house. There is also a library on Main Street.

Every Saturday, Anna goes to the market with her mother. They buy apples and bread there. After that, they have lunch in a small café.

questions.text: What do Anna and her mother buy at the market?
How does Anna probably feel about Saturdays?
What kind of town does Anna probably live in?
options: A quiet, pleasant town with shops and places to visit
A big city with no parks

vocabulary.definition: a green place outside where people walk and play
a place where people buy food and other things
a place where you can borrow books
a small place where you can buy drinks and food

paragraph_translations: Ania mieszka w małym miasteczku. Niedaleko jej domu jest duży park. Na ulicy Main jest też biblioteka.
Każdą sobotę Ania chodzi na targ z mamą. Tam kupują jabłka i chleb. Potem jedzą obiad w małej kawiarni.
